sourceOfTruth: Machine-readable task queue for active and upcoming agent work. Human-readable roadmap lives in docs/NEXT_STEPS.md.

tasks.summary: Lock the Cloudflare Pages + Supabase launch architecture and cost model.
acceptance: Launch target records Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Pages Functions for API endpoints, Supabase for data/auth/storage, and an Urblo-owned admin interface.
Current implementation reality remains explicit so agents do not assume backend features already exist.
Monthly cost baseline and optional cost drivers are documented for client planning.

tasks.summary: Design the Supabase schema for Projects, Stone Library, Products, Articles, media, and lead capture.
acceptance: Content entities and relationships are specified before migration work begins, including Products as a customer-maintained content type.
Draft/published/archive status, slug uniqueness, ordering, audit fields, and public read rules are included.
RLS expectations and service-role boundaries are recorded before any public API or admin implementation.

tasks.summary: Implement Cloudflare Pages deployment, preview, function routing, and rollback runbook.
acceptance: Repo-side Cloudflare Pages build command, output directory, SPA fallback, function routing, and launch headers are documented and verified locally.
Only future API routes are configured to invoke Pages Functions; static site traffic remains static.
Clean URL direct refresh works locally for declared routes.
Cloudflare Pages project creation, preview URL validation, production custom domain, DNS cutover, and rollback require account access before this task can be marked done.

tasks.summary: Replace mailto-only Contact and Sample Request flows with Supabase-backed submissions.
acceptance: Public form submissions are validated server-side, protected by Turnstile, stored in Supabase, and notify Urblo by email.
Admin users can view and update enquiry and sample-request status.
Visitor success and failure states are clear, and no submitted lead depends only on a local email client.

tasks.summary: Build the Urblo admin CMS for customer-maintained Projects, Stone Library, Products, Articles, media, and leads.
acceptance: Authenticated admin users can create, read, update, delete, draft, and publish Projects, Stone Library records, Products, Articles, and media records without code edits.
Article editing uses approved structured block types instead of arbitrary newsletter HTML.
Unpublished content remains hidden from the public site, and unauthenticated users cannot access admin routes.

acceptance: All first-viewport critical media, logo assets, homepage video/poster assets, and priority project/stone imagery have a controlled hosting path.
Homepage video has a launch-safe source, poster, compression/fallback policy, and mobile behavior.
Residual old-site URLs are inventoried with owner, risk, and migration priority.
